Lapwing reports flat/inconsistent preferences across these dimensions, so routing the friendly query to Avocet matches the work to the model that "wants" it without sacrificing any quality.

Since the documentation explicitly notes preferences don't affect output quality, this is a soft tiebreaker — but absent any other distinguishing factor, it's the reasonable basis for the choice.
